gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-syloti-nagri: Noto Sans Syloti Nagri has short ascenders and a tall x-height. Noto Sans Syloti Nagri handles the reading, while Revalia does the showing off, bold and wide-set with a g left open at the bottom.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Noto Sans Syriac has tall, rounded lowercase like blown glass bulbs. Noto Sans Syriac would read easily down a full page, its s shapes turning wide and gentle beneath the bold, widely spaced Revalia.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-syriac-weste: A lowercase g with an open lower curve gives Revalia its bold, expressive look. But Noto Sans Syriac Western is the dense, cable-thick counterweight, small letters packed with height and terminals held far from the stroke.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Noto Sans Tangsa opens its round letters wide and inviting. Its greatest strength is the pull against Revalia, whose bold, expressive display letters sit far looser than these short-stemmed, tall-bodied forms.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-thai-looped: Expressive, bold-edged Revalia strides across the line, wide-set and relaxed. Beneath it, Noto Sans Thai Looped brings tall bodies that look bold in lowercase, with spacious gaps at the curve terminals, grounding the sweep above.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-orienta: Bold, wide-striding headings above a hushed, open text line. Revalia carries the expression with its open-curved g, while Orienta lets its counters breathe, with little height difference between cases, quiet underneath.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-parkinsans: Revalia brings the swagger, bold and expressive, with a g whose lower curve stays open and letters set wide apart. Parkinsans stays crisp when shrunk, its stroke one thickness throughout.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-pathway-extreme: A lowercase g with an open lower curve marks Revalia as the loud, expressive one, its letters spread wide. Pathway Extreme does the steady work, with stubby ascenders and clear openings.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-puritan: Revalia takes the lead, bold, expressive and widely spaced. Puritan settles in beneath, its rounded forms staying open to the side with oversized counters in the e and the a giving the text an easy feel.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-questrial: A relaxed stride across widely separated letters defines Revalia, bold and expressive. Yet Questrial, a sans-serif cut flat from single-weight strokes, brings the quiet counterpoint, its t keeping crossbar and stem matched.
